## Project Overview

The project involved the complete design and implementation of an **IPTV system architecture** for IPTV Smart Pro. The objective was to modernize the streaming service by integrating advanced technology stacks that ensure scalability, reliability, and high performance for end-users.

### Challenges and Solutions

- **Scalability:** The architecture was redesigned to support high concurrency during peak streaming hours.
- **Performance:** Advanced streaming protocols were implemented to minimize latency and improve user experience.

### Technologies Used

- **Platform Architecture:** Customized IPTV framework.
- **Modern Streaming Stacks:** Integrated state-of-the-art streaming technologies focused on high-definition delivery and efficient data handling.

### Results Achieved

- Successful deployment within the 3-week project timeline.
- Implementation of robust technology layers ensuring long-term platform stability.
- Enhanced streaming efficiency and service quality.
Automated-Webinar-Registration-and-Lead-:
## Project Overview

This project involved the development of a fully automated system for webinar registration and lead management. The system streamlines the entire user journey, from initial sign-up via Telegram to post-webinar certificate delivery.

### The Problem

Manual registration and certificate issuance processes were inefficient and prone to human error, hindering the scalability of educational webinars.

### The Solution

- **Telegram Registration:** A custom Telegram bot allows users to register or retrieve existing records.
- **Data Handling:** Seamlessly updates databases with user details including specialized skills and contact info.
- **Automation Workflow:** Using n8n, the system handles the entire logic flow, from event registration to post-event engagement.
- **Certification:** Automated generation and distribution of personalized certificates upon webinar completion.

### Technologies Used

- **Automation Platform:** n8n
- **Communication:** Telegram Bot API
- **Presentation & Documentation:** Google Slides, Google Drive
- **Database:** Google Sheets
- **Integration:** Automated email notifications and data sync
